versions.content: Upon receiving a DENM, the DEN basic service makes the content of the DENM available to the V2X Applications. Received DENMs shall be sent to the upper application layer via their standardized AUTOSAR service interface V2xApplRxIndicationDenm. For Details see [11] chapter 5.3 and 8.4
